title: Introduce thin presubmit images and dependency curation adapter
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation:
We see long presubmit setup times (cold docker pulls, large toolchains) and occasional flakiness from installing large dev dependencies on CI. This PR introduces two complementary changes: (1) a set of thin presubmit images focused only on runtime/test deps to reduce container size and pull time; (2) a dep-curation adapter that integrates with our presubmit prober to report and optionally quarantine high-risk transitive dev-deps.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds devtools/presubmit-images/ with two Dockerfiles (node-thin, python-thin) and a small make target to build and push ephemeral tags for CI.
- Reworks .github/workflows/presubmit.yml to add a thin-image fastpath lane that runs faster smoke tests for small changes. Full matrix runs fall back to the previous image.
- Adds ci/toolchain/presubmit_adapter.go: an opt-in adapter that queries a curated dev-dep allowlist and annotates presubmit runs with a risk score.
- Adds scripts/presubmit/cache-warm.sh to prefetch common layers & warm runner caches for nightly builds.
- Updates docs/dev/presubmit.md with the new workflow and guidance for maintainers.

Design notes:
- Thin images only contain runtime libs and the minimal test harness; heavy build steps (e.g. full webpack, wheel building) still run in the standard image. This reduces pull time for fast feedback while preserving correctness for full CI runs.
- The dep-curation adapter is intentionally read-only by default. When the presubmit prober flags a high-risk transitive dep, it adds an annotation and opens a Linear task suggesting quarantine. Quarantine policy is opt-in and gated behind the "dep-curation" label.

Checklist:
- [x] Build thin images locally and verify size reduction (~65% smaller node image in our tests)
- [x] Smoke presubmit runs on branch using thin-image lane (green)
- [x] Full matrix runs on standard image (green)
- [x] Integration test: adapter annotates runs when encountering an allowlist miss (verified in SUP-4122 repro)
- [x] Docs updated and maintainers notified via #dev-infra

Testing and rollout plan:
- Initial rollout enables thin-image fastpath for PRs that change <= 10 files and are not in build-critical paths. We monitor flakiness/false-negatives via presubmit metrics (latency, failure rate) and will toggle coverage thresholds if we detect regressions.
- Dep-curation adapter will be deployed in monitoring mode for 2 weeks: it will only annotate. After stabilization we will enable automated quarantine for packages with repeated incidents.

Notes on compatibility & migration:
- No changes to public APIs. This is an infra-level optimization. Individual repos can opt-out by adding a PRESUBMIT_NO_THIN_IMAGE file at the repo root (documented in presubmit.md).

Related work: ENG-1829 (ci fast feedback), ENG-1893 (dep hygiene), SUP-4122 (support incident that exposed flaky dev deps).
